newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Biota shares bolt higher on trials.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Biota shares bolt higher on trials.

text.p: Shares in drug developer Biota Holdings Ltd jumped 35 cents to A$3.65 on Monday after the company said clinical trials of its anti-influenza drug, zanamivir, would begin in Australia in May.
Biota is developing the drug with UK-based pharmaceutical giant, Glaxo Wellcome Plc.

Biota said results from the phase IIB studies from the Northern Hemisphere together with earlier studies confirmed that zanamivir was a potentially valuable therapy for influenza and said data from these studies allowed for the optimisation of the phase three programme.

Concurrent with the phase three programme, the company said it would continue to collaborate with U.S. company Biostar Inc, to develop and commercialise a rapid and easy-to-use diagnostic aid for influenza.
"The trials are the only news on the stock and they seem to be making progress," said a dealer at a Sydney brokerage.
By 11.25 a.m. (0025 GMT), Biota shares had extended their gains to be 50 cents higher at A$3.80 on turnover of 176,154 shares.
